## The problem

What are you trying to accomplish that Connect24 doesn't currently
let you do? Describe the workflow, not just the missing button.

*Example: "When I generate 50 vouchers and print them, I want the
cards sorted by profile so the ones going to the same reseller are
grouped together. Right now I have to sort them manually."*

## Proposed solution

How would you like Connect24 to solve this? A specific UI element,
a setting, a new page — whatever fits.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why they didn't fit.

## Who benefits

- Is this for you specifically, or a broader group?
- How often would this matter? (daily, monthly, one-off)
- Is it a blocker or a nice-to-have?

## Mockups

If you can sketch the UI (Figma, Excalidraw, even a napkin photo),
that helps a lot. Optional.

## Additional context

Anything else — links to similar tools, references, prior discussions.
